{{Top}}
'''Cinnamon''' was a type of food additive. 

Some [[Liqueur/Legends|liqueurs]] were cinnamon flavored.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Holojournalist/Legends|holojournalist]] [[Den Dhur]] once ate a meal flavored with cinnamon at the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] chow hall.
